note: In Castle Provincial Park on Beaver Mines Lake, 20 km west of Pincher Creek on Hwy 507, 10 km southwest on Hwy 774 and 5 km south on an access road. Most sites are surrounded by trees and some have a view of the lake; boat launch, with a 12 km/h speed limit on the lake. No cell service in the park and no firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 5, 2026), booking site and campground map read. Confirmed 79 unserviced sites at $28, vault toilets, non-potable pump, phone. Season written from the page: May 15 - Sep 30 (2026), reservable May 15 - Sep 29; max length 90 ft from the booking site; no dump station. 2027 dates not published.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, no change proposed): agency: 'Most are surrounded by trees and some have a beautiful view of the lake.' The booking site tags C52, C54, C56 and C58 'Near Water'. On Esri imagery Loop C's lakeside road runs about 15-25 m from the shoreline with a continuous belt of conifers between (imagery estimate). Lakeview stands; trees between rule out more.

PIN: 49.3651,-114.3015 is at the road junction between Loop A (south-west) and Loops B-D (north-east); the agency's directions point (49.367977,-114.296636) is in Loop C/D, about 480 m north-east. Both are inside the campground; no move needed.
SITE COUNT: the agency page says 79 unserviced sites; shop.albertaparks.ca lists 80 (Loop A 31, B 13, C 19, D 17).
ADVISORY (not this campground): Castle PP Designated Camping Area 3B partial closure May 1 - Nov 30, 2026. shop.albertaparks.ca shows the park 'Open through Sun Nov 29 2026' at park level.
